explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/627: with f(n) the maximum of χ(G)/ω(G) over n-vertex graphs, does lim f(n)/(n/(log₂ n)²) exist? maxChromaticCliqueRatio n is the (attained) supremum of χ/ω over graphs on Fin n. The statement asks for a finite limit L, which is right since f(n) ≍ n/(log₂ n)². Faithful.
